name: Easy Recovery
effortGuidance: RPE 2 to 3. You can talk in full sentences without thinking about breath.

provenanceDefault.source: MVP HEURISTIC — session shape; effort is talk-test only

name: Easy Steady
effortGuidance: RPE 3 to 4. A conversation you could hold with a friend walking beside you.

provenanceDefault.source: MVP HEURISTIC — session shape; effort is talk-test only

name: Tempo
effortGuidance: RPE 6 to 7. You can speak a short phrase. A full sentence would make you pause.

provenanceDefault.source: MVP HEURISTIC — intervals are a spice after a base exists (Programming Guide)

name: Threshold
effortGuidance: RPE 7 to 8. A few words at a time. You would not want to talk.

provenanceDefault.source: MVP HEURISTIC — session shape; not a lactate measurement

name: Long Intervals
effortGuidance: RPE 7 to 8. You can speak a few words, not a sentence.

provenanceDefault.source: MVP HEURISTIC — work and recover lengths are a starting shape, not measured

name: Short Intervals
effortGuidance: RPE 8. A word or two. Then easy until you can talk again.

provenanceDefault.source: MVP HEURISTIC — work and recover lengths are a starting shape, not measured

name: Sprint Intervals
effortGuidance: RPE 9 to 10. No talking on the work bout. Easy until breath is a conversation again.

provenanceDefault.source: Coach & AI Programming Guide — intervals are a spice after a base exists. Never a beginner prescription.
